messages:
Elaine - Marketing: Heads-up: aiming to publish the release tomorrow. Short list I need confirmed before I draft the blog: changelog URL, canonical docs link (no redirects), webinar time + embargo, and UTMs for tracking. Please drop single-line status replies.

Raj - Eng: changelog: https://redwood-inference.dev/changelog/2026-04-02-release-final. Good to go. Minor note about batching defaults in the infra section. No blocker.

Lina - Docs: docs live at https://docs.redwoodinference.com/releases/2026-04-02 90% done. Waiting on a tiny example from Raj (30m). ETA docs publish: 09:50 PT tomorrow if snippet arrives.

Raj - Eng: snippet: ```js
// simple generate example for blog/docs
const r = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood/throughput-7b', prompt: 'Explain vector caching', max_tokens: 120 });
console.log(r.text);
```
Use that exact call. Canary tested it.

Nora - Growth: Webinar scheduled 10:30 PT (starts 10:35). Recommend embargo lift 10:30 PT. UTMs: utm_source=social&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=apr02_release. For webinar registrants add tag release_tag=apr02 and lead_source=webinar.

Elaine - Marketing: Perfect. Raj 97 if deploy starts at 07:30 PT, will canary finish before 10:30? Need to ensure docs + blog live at embargo.

Raj - Eng: Deploy plan: 07:30 deploy -> 07:30-08:00 canary -> 08:00-09:00 grad rollout -> 09:00 full traffic. Buffer ok for 10:30 embargo. If canary fails we rollback; rollback tested.

Lina - Docs: I'll merge the snippet when Raj posts it to the repo. If merged by 08:00 PT I can publish at 09:45 PT.

Nora - Growth: Landing modal copy draft: "Live demo: see Redwood Inference cut latency and cost. Join the release webinar." Shorten if needed. Also: please ensure registration modal sets the utm params and fires Airtable webhook for lead routing.

Elaine - Marketing: Shorten: "Live demo: low-latency, low-cost LLM inference. Register now." Nora, drop final modal HTML or modal copy here and ops will wire webhooks.

Nora - Growth: Final modal copy ready, posting in #growth in 10m with tracking snippet.

Raj - Eng: rollout health check: if p95 latency > 2.5x baseline OR error rate > 0.5% during canary, rollback. Policy snippet for ops:
```
rollout:
  canary: 30m
  progressive_windows: [30m, 30m]
  thresholds:
    p95_latency_multiplier: 2.5
    error_rate_pct: 0.5
```

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by Raj at 1799997600. Artifact: artifact-release-2026-04-02.tar.gz. Canary and rollout configs applied.

Elaine - Marketing: Final publish plan if green: 10:30 PT blog + changelog + docs all go live, 10:35 PT webinar starts, 10:40 PT social posts. Nora queue social for 10:40.

Lina - Docs: I'll do a quick doc spot-check after publish and post any micro fixes here.

Raj - Eng: I'll monitor canary and post status updates in this thread. Oncall will be looped automatically.

Elaine - Marketing: Great. Everyone add a quick emoji when you see this to confirm: I'll use this thread as the ground truth for publish. :white_check_mark:
